mapper.select: SELECT c.instance_id AS connector_id,c.base_url AS endpoint,c.auth_type,c.auth_credential_encrypted AS encrypted_credential, v.descriptor::text AS descriptor,v.content_hash AS descriptor_hash, COALESCE(c.headers->>'MCP-Protocol-Version','2026-07-28') AS protocol_version, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'model_invocable')='boolean' THEN (v.descriptor->>'model_invocable')::boolean END AS model_invocable, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'confirmation_policy')='string' THEN v.descriptor->>'confirmation_policy' END AS confirmation_policy, jsonb_exists(v.descriptor,'output_schema') AS output_schema_declared, COALESCE(v.descriptor->>#{identityField}, CASE WHEN v.descriptor->>'effect' IN ('READ_ONLY','IDEMPOTENT_WRITE') THEN 'ARGUMENTS' ELSE 'HANDLE' END) AS call_identity_policy, (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))::text||':'||value,'' ORDER BY convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'sensitive_fields')='array' THEN v.descriptor->'sensitive_fields' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) elements(value)) unique_elements) AS sensitive_fields, (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))::text||':'||value,'' ORDER BY convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'provider_requirements')='array' THEN v.descriptor->'provider_requirements' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) elements(value)) unique_elements) AS provider_requirements FROM public.nw_tool_deployments d JOIN public.nw_capability_versions anchor ON anchor.id=d.tool_version_id JOIN public.nw_capability_versions v ON v.id::text=#{target.capability.versionId} AND v.definition_id=anchor.definition_id JOIN public.nw_connector_instances c ON c.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND c.instance_id=d.provider_ref WHERE d.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND d.deployment_key=#{target.deploymentId} AND d.revision=#{target.deploymentRevision} AND d.provider_type='MCP' AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND v.id::text=#{target.capability.versionId} AND v.definition_id::text=#{target.capability.capabilityId} AND v.capability_type='TOOL' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND (v.tenant_id IS NULL OR v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id) AND c.status='active' AND c.executor_type='mcp' AND c.auth_type IN ('none','bearer') AND (c.vault_secret_path IS NULL OR btrim(c.vault_secret_path)='') AND (c.headers='{}'::jsonb OR c.headers IN ('{"MCP-Protocol-Version":"2026-07-28"}'::jsonb,'{"MCP-Protocol-Version":"2025-11-25"}'::jsonb)) AND jsonb_typeof(c.capabilities)='array' AND jsonb_exists(c.capabilities,#{tool}) AND jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'input_schema')='object' AND jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(v.descriptor->'output_schema','{}'::jsonb))='object' AND v.descriptor->'input_schema'=CAST(#{target.inputSchema.canonicalJson} AS jsonb) AND COALESCE(v.descriptor->'output_schema','{}'::jsonb)=CAST(#{target.outputSchema.canonicalJson} AS jsonb) AND jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'model_invocable')='boolean' AND jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'confirmation_policy')='string' AND v.descriptor->>'confirmation_policy' IN ('NEVER','POLICY','ALWAYS') AND (NOT jsonb_exists(v.descriptor,'sensitive_fields') OR jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'sensitive_fields') IN ('null','array')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'sensitive_fields')='array' THEN v.descriptor->'sensitive_fields' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) item WHERE jsonb_typeof(item)<>'string' OR btrim(item#>>'{}')='' OR item#>>'{}'<>btrim(item#>>'{}')) AND (NOT jsonb_exists(v.descriptor,'provider_requirements') OR jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'provider_requirements') IN ('null','array')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.descriptor->'provider_requirements')='array' THEN v.descriptor->'provider_requirements' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) item WHERE jsonb_typeof(item)<>'string' OR btrim(item#>>'{}')='' OR item#>>'{}'<>btrim(item#>>'{}')) AND v.descriptor->>'effect'=#{target.effect} AND v.descriptor->'idempotent'=to_jsonb(CAST(#{target.idempotent} AS boolean)) AND v.descriptor->'timeout_ms'=to_jsonb(CAST(#{timeout} AS bigint))

SELECT b.tenant_id, b.handle, b.deployment_id, b.deployment_revision, b.capability_id, b.version_id, b.input_schema_id, b.input_schema, b.output_schema_id, b.output_schema, b.effect, b.idempotent, b.timeout, b.connector_id, b.endpoint, b.auth_type, b.encrypted_credential, b.descriptor, b.descriptor_hash, b.tool_name, b.protocol_version, b.content_digest, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.descriptor::jsonb->'model_invocable')='boolean' THEN (b.descriptor::jsonb->>'model_invocable')::boolean END AS model_invocable, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.descriptor::jsonb->'confirmation_policy')='string' THEN b.descriptor::jsonb->>'confirmation_policy' END AS confirmation_policy, jsonb_exists(b.descriptor::jsonb,'output_schema') AS output_schema_declared, COALESCE(b.descriptor::jsonb->>#{identityField}, CASE WHEN b.effect IN ('READ_ONLY','IDEMPOTENT_WRITE') THEN 'ARGUMENTS' ELSE 'HANDLE' END) AS call_identity_policy, (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))::text||':'||value,'' ORDER BY convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.descriptor::jsonb->'sensitive_fields')='array' THEN b.descriptor::jsonb->'sensitive_fields' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) elements(value)) unique_elements) AS sensitive_fields, (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))::text||':'||value,'' ORDER BY convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.descriptor::jsonb->'provider_requirements')='array' THEN b.descriptor::jsonb->'provider_requirements' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) elements(value)) unique_elements) AS provider_requirements FROM public.nw_runtime_mcp_bindings b WHERE b.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) AND b.handle=#{target.handle.value} AND b.deployment_id=#{target.deploymentId} AND b.deployment_revision=#{target.deploymentRevision} AND b.capability_id=#{target.capability.capabilityId} AND b.version_id=#{target.capability.versionId}
